source: Cyclic laser scanning of Slovenia 2023-2025 (CLSS), classified point cloud GKOT: Surveying and Mapping Authority of the Republic of Slovenia (GURS), CC BY 4.0
origin: core south-west corner, D96/TM E 464000 m, N 114000 m; grid north
record: uint16 east and uint16 north of the south-west cell (m from the origin), uint8 columns, uint8 rows, uint16 base height (dm above the datum; the lowest ground under the roof minus 0.3 m), then rows x columns uint8 roof heights above the base in 0.2 m units (0: no roof), rows south to north, columns west to east; cells are 1 m
